hero.title: Crafting Spaces That Tell Your Story
hero.subtitle: Boutique interior design studio creating timeless, functional spaces that reflect your unique vision.

about.studioDescription: Shika is a boutique interior design studio dedicated to creating spaces that are both beautiful and deeply personal. Founded with a passion for thoughtful design, we believe every space has a story waiting to be told.
about.studioDescription2: Our approach blends contemporary aesthetics with timeless elegance, creating environments that feel both fresh and enduring. We work closely with each client to understand their lifestyle, preferences, and aspirations, transforming these insights into spaces that truly feel like home.
about.philosophyDescription: We believe that great design goes beyond aesthetics. It's about creating spaces that enhance daily life, evoke emotion, and stand the test of time. Every material, color, and texture is chosen with intention.
about.founderBio: Shika is the shared vision of two designers, Karoiline and Shiraz. Together they lead every project from first sketch to final styling, balancing two distinct perspectives into one calm, considered language. From family homes to kiosks and burger joints, they bring the same attention to light, texture and detail, and the same commitment to designing spaces that feel personal to the people who live and work in them.

values.title: Our Values
values.craftsmanshipDesc: We believe in the power of expert craftsmanship and attention to detail in every element of design.
values.sustainabilityDesc: We prioritize eco-friendly materials and sustainable practices in all our projects.
values.collaborationDesc: We work hand-in-hand with our clients, architects, and artisans to bring each vision to life.
values.innovationDesc: We stay at the forefront of design trends while maintaining timeless sensibility.

process.subtitle: From concept to completion, we guide you through every step of your design journey.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: We begin with an in-depth conversation to understand your vision, lifestyle, and aspirations. This is where we listen, learn, and start to envision the possibilities for your space.

concept.title: Concept Development
concept.description: Our team develops a comprehensive design concept that captures your vision. We present mood boards, material palettes, and spatial layouts that bring the concept to life.

design.title: Detailed Design
design.description: We refine every detail — from furniture selections to lighting plans, custom millwork to fabric choices. Each element is carefully curated to create a cohesive, harmonious space.

execution.title: Execution & Styling
execution.description: We oversee the entire implementation process, coordinating with contractors and artisans to ensure every detail is executed to perfection. The final styling brings your space to life.

projects.subtitle: A curated selection of our work across residential and commercial spaces.

a11y.title: Accessibility adjustments
a11y.shortcutHint: Keyboard shortcut: Alt+A opens and closes this menu

accessibility.intro: Shika Design believes that everyone should be able to use our website independently, with equal access and dignity. We have invested effort and resources so that people with disabilities can browse the site, learn about our work and contact us, in accordance with the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law, 5758-1998, and the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Accessibility Adjustments for Service) Regulations, 5773-2013.
accessibility.standard: The site has been adapted to conform with Israeli Standard IS 5568, "Accessibility Guidelines for Web Content", at level AA. The standard is based on the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.0, and we also work towards WCAG 2.1 level AA.
measures: Every page can be used with a keyboard alone, with a clearly visible focus indicator
A "Skip to main content" link at the top of every page
A consistent page structure with landmarks and an orderly heading hierarchy, for screen readers
Text alternatives for meaningful images; decorative images are hidden from assistive technology
Text and background colours that meet the AA contrast ratios
Labelled form fields, with required fields marked and confirmation messages announced
Layouts that adapt to any screen size and to browser zoom of up to 200%
Animations that respect the system "reduce motion" setting and can be stopped
Page language and reading direction declared for English, Hebrew and Arabic
Links that open in a new tab are announced as such
accessibility.menuIntro: The accessibility button in the corner of every page (or the Alt+A keyboard shortcut) opens a menu with these adjustments. Your choices are saved in your browser for future visits:
menu: Text size: enlarge the text up to 200%
High contrast: black background, white text and yellow links
Grayscale: display the site without colour
Highlight links: underline and mark every link
Readable font: replace decorative fonts with a simple, clear font
Text spacing: increase line, word and letter spacing
Stop animations: stop all movement and transitions
Big cursor: enlarge the mouse pointer
Highlight focus: a strong highlight on the element in focus
Reset: return all adjustments to the default
accessibility.compat: The site was checked with current versions of Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge, on desktop and mobile, and with the NVDA and VoiceOver screen readers.
accessibility.limitations: We continue to review and improve the site. Despite our efforts, some content may not yet be fully accessible. Project photographs are described by the name of the project rather than in full detail, and linked external sites (such as Instagram and Facebook) are not under our control. If you encounter a barrier, please let us know and we will do our best to fix it.
accessibility.meetings: If you need an accessibility accommodation for a meeting with us or for receiving our services, please let us know in advance and we will be happy to arrange it.
